home.kicker: A transparent pricing engine for hotels
home.lede: Rate Ledger prices every room, every night, from demand, forecasts and events, and keeps each price inside limits the hotel has approved. Every price has a reason, a bound and an audit trail.
home.specimen_note: Open any room below to see its real, live breakdown.
home.search_title: Find a stay and see why the price is what it is
home.how_1_d: Bookings, searches, cancellations, lead time and approved local events are read every business day.
home.how_2_d: Eight bounded factors adjust the room's reference rate. A forecast only moves the price as far as its evidence allows.
home.how_3_d: Floor, ceiling and daily-move limits set by the hotel always win. Each price is stored with its reason and replays exactly.
